app.name: FileHop
app.tagline: Any file, any format, on your device.
app.title: FileHop — any file, any format, on your device
hero.h1: Convert anything, and let nothing leave this device
hero.lead: Drop an image, a PDF, a spreadsheet or an archive. FileHop reads it here, in this tab, with your own CPU. There is no upload button because there is no upload.
hero.proof: Watch the Network tab while a conversion runs: it stays empty.
drop.title: Drop files here
drop.hint: or paste with {kbd}, or click to choose. Images, PDF, CSV, JSON, YAML, ZIP, TAR, Markdown and more.
drop.ring_hint: Release on a format to convert everything to it.
drop.add_more: Drop more files anywhere on this page

presets.empty: No presets yet. Set up a conversion you like, then save it.
privacy.title: What this page sends
privacy.body: Nothing. Files are opened with the File API, decoded and encoded in this tab, and handed back through a blob URL. There is no server-side conversion and no queue, and no account is needed. If you sign in with HOP ID, the server keeps only your session, never a file.
privacy.network: Network requests since this tab opened: {n}
privacy.network_note: Fonts, icons and code come from this same origin.
confirm.drop_body: Files in the queue: {n}. They and their results leave this tab's memory; a result you have not downloaded is gone.
confirm.clear_body: Cards to remove: {n} (done, failed or stopped). A result you have not downloaded is gone.
how.title: Three steps, no round trip
how.s1_p: The type is read from the bytes, not from the name, so a JPEG called .txt still opens.
how.s2_p: Each job runs off the main thread, one worker per slot, so the page keeps scrolling.
how.s3_p: Results stay in memory until you take them. Remove a card and its bytes are gone.
formats.title: What goes in, what comes out
formats.images_v: PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP, TIFF, ICO, SVG in → WebP, AVIF, JPEG, PNG, PDF out. Resize, and metadata is stripped because it never reaches the encoder.
formats.pdf_v: Merge, split, rotate, pick pages, render pages to PNG or JPEG, read the document info.
formats.data_v: CSV, TSV, JSON and YAML, converted both ways with the header row kept.
formats.text_v: Markdown to HTML, HTML to Markdown or plain text.
formats.archive_v: ZIP and TAR listed and repacked, GZIP both ways, any file wrapped into a ZIP.
formats.hash_v: SHA-256, BLAKE3 and MD5, streamed so a 2 GB file does not have to fit in memory.
formats.soon: Not here yet, on purpose: DOCX/LaTeX (needs pandoc), RAR and 7z (read-only, no WASM yet), video and audio (needs WebCodecs work).
footer.note: Self-hosted, no trackers, no third-party scripts.
licenses.title: Libraries in this build
licenses.body: Each one is bundled or vendored here; nothing is loaded from a third-party CDN.
err.title: That did not work
err.cannot_decode: The browser could not decode this file. The bytes may be damaged, or the format is not supported by this browser.
err.avif_not_supported: This browser cannot write AVIF. Choose WebP instead — it is supported everywhere FileHop runs.
err.encoder_missing: The encoder refused that format. Try another target.
err.bad_page_selection: That page range does not match the document. Try something like 1-3,7.
err.archive_too_big: The archive expands past 4 GB, which is beyond what one tab should hold.
err.archive_ratio: The archive expands suspiciously far for its size, so it was stopped before it could fill memory.
err.json_parse: That file is not valid JSON.
err.merge_needs_two: Merge needs at least two PDFs in the queue.
err.csv_parse: That file could not be read as a table.
err.unsupported: That conversion is not available yet.
err.worker_crash: The worker stopped unexpectedly. The file may be too large for this device.
err.out_of_memory: This device ran out of memory for this file. Try a smaller max width.
err.archive_unsafe_path: The archive contains a path that points outside itself (../). It was refused.
err.archive_bad_zip: That file is not a readable ZIP or GZIP archive.
err.svg_needs_main_thread: This SVG has to be rendered in the page, which is not available right now. Reload and try again.
toast.limit: The queue holds 50 files at a time. {added} of {total} were added; convert or clear this batch first.
licenses.no_agpl: PDF reading uses pdf.js, not MuPDF. No AGPL engine is present in this build.
auth.err_expired: The sign-in took too long or started in another browser. Please try again.
auth.err_invalid: This sign-in link is not valid any more. Please try again.
auth.err_failed: Signing in failed on our side. Please try again in a moment.
